title: General Daniel Hokanson, Chief of the National Guard Bureau visits the 106th Rescue Wing
description: Army General Daniel R. Hokanson, Chief of the National Guard Bureau boards an HH-60G Pave Hawk helicopter flown by the 106th Rescue Wing of the New York Air National Guard during a visit to the wing at F.S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base in Westhampton Beach, New York on Nov, 5, 2022. The 106th Rescue Wing Airmen are trained to conduct search and rescue missions in combat environments.(U.S. Air National Guard photo video by Major Michael O’Hagan)
